packageRules.description: nginx's stable releases use even minor versions (1.28.x, 1.30.x); odd ones (1.27.x, 1.29.x, 1.31.x) are mainline/development builds — stay on the stable line rather than the newest tag available.
signature is hard-pinned by ssh-key 0.6.7's own manifest (^2) — allow patch/minor churn within 2.x, block the 3.x jump.
ssh-encoding is hard-pinned by ssh-key 0.6.7's own manifest (^0.2) — a 0.x minor bump is semver-breaking, so only allow 0.2.x patches.

rand_chacha 0.10's ChaCha20Rng doesn't implement the trait generation ssh_key::PrivateKey::random requires (that bound comes from signature 2.x, transitively pinned by ssh-key 0.6.7) — only allow 0.3.x patches, not the breaking 0.x minor bump to 0.10. ssh-key's only newer line is an unreleased 0.7.0 release-candidate chain (still RC as of this check) — revisit once it ships stable.
